xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for #2843 — close monitor-as-implementer Gap C/D hole after blocked drive-to:merge-ready DONE

plan.title: swarm: monitor must not self-implement after drive-to:merge-ready leaf exits BLOCKED/DONE-with-blockers

narratives.Description: A Cursor drive-to:merge-ready leaf that exits with DONE while still blocked pulls the cohort monitor into inline Greptile fixes and pr:watch. Close the doctrine hole so Tier-1 monitors must resume or background-dispatch ONE continuation leaf instead of self-implementing.
narratives.Origin: Ingested from https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/2843; recurrence in cohort-2026-07-26-hooks-appsec-coverage after #2839 PR #2842.
narratives.Overview: False-terminal DONE plus swarm Phase 5 'monitor MAY run review-cycle itself' licensed Gap D violation. Align preamble, swarm skill, and review-cycle on BLOCKED+REDISPATCH_OK and a Tier-1-only continuation playbook.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Edit the agent-prompt-preamble.md template file §11 DONE/BLOCKED contract module so drive-to:merge-ready reserves DONE for merge-ready (or merge+scope:complete) and requires BLOCKED with PR/SHA/blocker class/worktree/REDISPATCH_OK otherwise. 2) Edit the deft-directive-swarm/SKILL.md skill file Phase 5 Gap C fallback: replace 'monitor MAY run review-cycle itself' with Tier-1 MUST background-dispatch ONE continuation leaf; add a completion-notification decision tree; keep monitor-inline only for Tier 3 or explicit operator consent. 3) Mirror Worker-owns-lifecycle wording in the deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md skill file. 4) If consumer-facing, update the agents-entry.md template file and run task agents:refresh. 5) Verify with rg evidence on those files plus CHANGELOG [Unreleased] and meta/lessons.md citing #2843; optional eval/contract test for DONE-with-blockers.
narratives.UserStory: As a swarm monitor, I want blocked merge-ready leaves to force a single continuation dispatch instead of inline fixes, so that the parent conversation stays interactive and Gap C lifecycle ownership stays intact.

items.title: Given a drive-to:merge-ready worker, when it exits mid-cycle, then status is BLOCKED with REDISPATCH_OK not DONE.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a worker scoped drive-to:merge-ready, when Greptile/CI/behind still blocks merge-ready, then the exit message uses BLOCKED (not DONE) and includes PR number, HEAD SHA, blocker class, worktree path, and REDISPATCH_OK.

items.title: Given Tier 1 is available, when a leaf exits blocked, then the monitor must dispatch one continuation leaf.

narrative.Acceptance: Given Cursor Task or another Tier-1 primitive is available, when a cohort leaf exits BLOCKED or DONE-with-blockers, then the swarm skill requires background-dispatch of ONE continuation leaf owning fix batches + pr:watch + merge readiness, and forbids monitor-inline implementation without operator consent.

items.title: Given host completion notifications, when the monitor parses status, then the follow-up playbook is explicit.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a subagent completion notification, when the monitor follows Phase 4/5, then DONE+merge-ready may merge/scope:complete, BLOCKED must resume or redispatch one leaf, and FAILED/silent uses verify:subagent-alive REDISPATCH_OK — with no code edits in the monitor turn on Tier 1.

items.title: Given the doctrine change, when it ships, then CHANGELOG and a short lesson name the recurrence.

narrative.Acceptance: Given preamble/swarm/review-cycle updates land, when the PR opens, then CHANGELOG [Unreleased] and a short meta/lessons (or packs:slice) entry name the monitor-as-implementer recurrence and point at #2843.

references.title: Issue #2843: swarm: monitor must not self-implement after drive-to:merge-ready leaf exits BLOCKED/DONE-with-blockers

expected_outputs: DONE reserved for merge-ready on drive-to:merge-ready
